lines.en: label halloween4:
: Friend! I have returned!
lines.zh: : 朋友！我回来了！

lines.en: scene kaorihalloween1
Kaori trots over to me shortly after Rin and Futaba get on the bus and, to my surprise, she’s wearing a brand new outfit.
lines.zh: Rin 和 Futaba 上车后没多久，Kaori 就小跑着来到我身边，而让我意外的是，她换了一身全新的衣服。

lines.en: Did she really get changed just to go for a walk?
lines.zh: 她真的只是为了散步就特意换了衣服？

lines.en: And why does she even want to go for a walk in the first place?
lines.zh: 还有，她到底为什么想散步？

lines.en: Is this an actual date all of a sudden?
lines.zh: 这突然之间算是真正的约会了吗？

lines.en: : Hey. New clothes?
lines.zh: : 嘿。新衣服？

lines.en: : Yes! My other clothes became all squish-squooshy after turning the dishes clean!
lines.zh: : 是的！我洗完碗之后，原来那身衣服变得湿哒哒的了！

lines.en: : The correct word is “wet” for future reference.
lines.zh: : 正确的说法是“湿”，以后记住了。

lines.en: : Squish-squooshy is better! Use my word instead!
lines.zh: : 湿哒哒更好！用我的词！

lines.en: : Fine, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 行吧，Kaori。

lines.en: : So, where are we going?
lines.zh: : 那我们要去哪儿？

lines.en: : Places!
lines.zh: : 各个地方！

lines.en: : And is there any reason in particular you want to go to “places” with me?
lines.zh: : 那你有什么特别的理由想和我去“各个地方”吗？

lines.en: : I want you to teach me more about humans!
lines.zh: : 我想让你教我更多关于人类的事！

lines.en: : Today, an angry woman customer yelled at me for the way I speak! It was quite frightening!
lines.zh: : 今天，一个生气的女客人因为我的说话方式冲我大吼！相当吓人！

lines.en: : And so I must work hard to obtain the proper knowledge that will prevent me from hurting anyone’s feelings hundreds of years from now when I am finally prepared.
lines.zh: : 所以我必须努力掌握正确的知识，这样等几百年后我终于准备好的时候，就不会伤害任何人的感情了。

lines.en: : If you’re talking in dog years again, which I’m assuming you are, I can’t imagine it will take that long.
lines.zh: : 如果你说的又是什么狗年算法——我猜是的——那我想应该不用那么久。

lines.en: scene kaorihalloween2
: Really? You think I will be able to master human conversation so quickly?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？你觉得我能这么快就掌握人类的对话？

lines.en: : Are teachers really that powerful?
lines.zh: : 老师真的那么厉害吗？

lines.en: : No, I just have a lot of faith in you for reasons beyond my comprehension.
lines.zh: : 不是，我只是出于某种我自己也说不清的理由，非常相信你。

lines.en: : Faith? In the Queen of Spiders? I’m shocked.
lines.zh: : 信任？信任蛛后？我很震惊。

lines.en: : I am too, to be honest. You haven’t really done anything to deserve it, really.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我也挺震惊的。你其实也没做什么值得我信任的事，真的。

lines.en: : Is this what humans call “flirting?”
lines.zh: : 这就是人类说的“调情”吗？

lines.en: : Are you attempting to woo me because I am suddenly wearing tight-fitting fabric? Must I remove my clothes a second time and exchange them for yet another pair?
lines.zh: : 你是因为我突然穿上了紧身的布料才想追求我吗？难道我要再脱一次衣服，换上另一套？

lines.en: : I don’t think that will be necessary.
lines.zh: : 我觉得没必要。

lines.en: scene kaorihalloween1
: I understand! I am overjoyed to hear this because I did not bring another pair with me today.
lines.zh: : 我明白！听到你这么说我很高兴，因为我今天没带另一套衣服。

lines.en: : I didn’t imagine you did. Bringing two changes of clothes to work would be strange even for you.
lines.zh: : 我就知道你没带。带两套换洗衣服去上班，就算是你也太奇怪了。

lines.en: : So, where are these places you want to go, Kaori?
lines.zh: : 那么，Kaori，你想去的那些地方是哪儿？

lines.en: : Good question, Friend!
lines.zh: : 好问题，朋友！

lines.en: : Tell me, have you ever heard of “chickens” before?
lines.zh: : 告诉我，你以前听说过“鸡”吗？

lines.en: : As a matter of fact, I have.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我听说过。

lines.en: : Would your body be consumed by excitement if I told you there was a place with many chickens?
lines.zh: : 如果我告诉你有个地方有很多鸡，你的身体会被兴奋吞没吗？

lines.en: : Not really, no.
lines.zh: : 不太会，不会。

lines.en: scene kaorihalloween3
: There is nothing to fear, Friend!
lines.zh: : 没什么好怕的，朋友！

lines.en: : I was afraid at first as well, but everything will be okay! They are kind animals!
lines.zh: : 我一开始也害怕，但一切都会没事的！它们是善良的动物！

lines.en: : And they make such strange noises! Like...BACAWK and...SQUAWK!
lines.zh: : 而且它们会发出特别奇怪的声音！比如……咯咕咕！还有……嘎！

lines.en: scene kaorihalloween4
: Do not worry. I will protect you.
lines.zh: : 别担心。我会保护你。

lines.en: : The spider is a natural predator of the chicken.
lines.zh: : 蜘蛛是鸡的天然掠食者。

lines.en: : No it isn’t, Kaori. That’s not a thing.
lines.zh: : 才不是，Kaori。根本没这回事。

lines.en: scene kaorihalloween5
: It is! I will show you!
lines.zh: : 就是！我证明给你看！

lines.en: : All you must do is follow me into a nearby alleyway three squares from here!
lines.zh: : 你只要跟我走进离这里三个街区外的一条小巷就行！

lines.en: : Do you mean three blocks?
lines.zh: : 你是说三个街区？

lines.en: : Squares and blocks are the same! I will not be deceived by a man who fears chickens!
lines.zh: : 方块和街区是一样的！我不会让一个怕鸡的男人骗到！

lines.en: : I don’t fear-
lines.zh: : 我才不怕——

lines.en: : Actually, fine. I’ll follow you to the sketchy chicken alleyway.
lines.zh: : 算了，行吧。我就跟你去那条可疑的鸡巷。

lines.en: scene black
Kaori quickly walks up to my side and points in the direction we’ll be heading to make it to the mysterious abundance of chickens.
lines.zh: Kaori 快步走到我身边，指了指我们要去的方向——那里就是那神秘的一大群鸡的所在。

lines.en: It’s not exactly what I had in mind for our first “date,” but I guess it fits in with Kaori’s image.
lines.zh: 这跟我原先设想的第一次“约会”不太一样，不过我想这倒挺符合 Kaori 的形象。

lines.en: Whatever that image may be.
lines.zh: 不管那个形象到底是什么。

lines.en: I’ll honestly just accept anything she does as normal at this point.
lines.zh: 说真的，到了这个地步，她做什么我都会当是正常的了。

lines.en: And if she just-so-happened to have found a nearby chicken coop or something, I see no harm in going there with her if it will make her happy.
lines.zh: 而如果她碰巧发现了附近有个鸡窝什么的，只要能让她开心，我觉得陪她去也没什么坏处。

lines.en: scene kaorihalloween6
: So, this bar you speak of- does it have a name?
lines.zh: : 那么，你说的那家酒吧——它有名字吗？

lines.en: : I...actually don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我……其实不知道。

lines.en: : Sara’s Bar, I guess? We can just call it that.
lines.zh: : 就叫 Sara 的酒吧吧？我们就这么叫好了。

lines.en: : Sara? What is a Sara?
lines.zh: : Sara？Sara 是什么？

lines.en: : Sara is a friend of mine who owns the bar. She’s the one you’ll be covering for.
lines.zh: : Sara 是我的一个朋友，那家酒吧是她开的。你要顶的就是她的班。

lines.en: : I need to work extra hours because Sara wants to become dizzy instead of working?
lines.zh: : 我得加班，是因为 Sara 想喝晕而不是工作？

lines.en: : That is a bad mindset. Humans must work hard if they ever want to own pets.
lines.zh: : 这种心态很不好。人类如果想养宠物，就必须努力工作。

lines.en: : I don’t think she wants a pet, but I’ll let her know tonight that she’ll have to step it up if she does.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她不想要宠物，不过我今晚会告诉她：如果想养的话，她得更努力才行。

lines.en: scene kaorihalloween7
: Thank you! Is this Sara person a very close friend?
lines.zh: : 谢谢！这个叫 Sara 的人是很亲近的朋友吗？

lines.en: : She will not steal you from me, will she?
lines.zh: : 她不会把你从我身边抢走吧？

lines.en: : Well, tonight she probably will. But not overall.
lines.zh: : 嗯，今晚她大概会。但总的来说不会。

lines.en: : I will be working tonight, so that is fine. I do not know the rules of “The Sara’s Bar,” but I don’t think I am allowed to have fun while I am pouring liquids into cylinders.
lines.zh: : 反正今晚我要上班，所以没关系。我不知道“Sara 的酒吧”的规矩，但我觉得在把液体倒进圆柱体的时候应该不能玩乐。

lines.en: : I’m sure you can if you want. Sara’s pretty laid back.
lines.zh: : 你想的话肯定可以。Sara 挺随和的。

lines.en: : Laid-back?
lines.zh: : 随和？

lines.en: : Does she need one of those chairs with wheels? I do not know the correct name for them.
lines.zh: : 那她需要那种带轮子的椅子吗？我不知道那东西叫什么。

lines.en: : Wheelchair. And no.
lines.zh: : 轮椅。而且不需要。

lines.en: scene kaorihalloween8
: Yes! Wheelchair! Like the ones they have in the hospital!
lines.zh: : 对！轮椅！就像医院里的那种！

lines.en: : Are hospitals something you’re familiar with, Kaori?
lines.zh: : Kaori，你对医院很熟吗？

lines.en: scene kaorihalloween6
: Yes! Such delicious juice they have! And they come in the perfect sized canisters!
lines.zh: : 是的！那里的果汁特别好喝！而且装在大小正合适的罐子里！

lines.en: : Would you like to visit the hospital with me one day, Friend? If you ask them very politely for the juices, they sometimes give you extra!
lines.zh: : 朋友，你哪天要不要跟我一起去医院？如果你非常有礼貌地问他们要果汁，他们有时会多给你几罐！

lines.en: : Such a generous location!
lines.zh: : 那地方真是慷慨！

lines.en: : Hospitals aren’t really a place people are supposed to go for juice, Kaori. They have juice in convenience stores.
lines.zh: : Kaori，医院可不是让人去喝果汁的地方。便利店就有果汁。

lines.en: : The convenient juices are too large! It is not convenient at all!
lines.zh: : 便利果汁太大了！一点都不便利！

lines.en: : Hospital-sized juices are ideal for consumption.
lines.zh: : 医院那种大小的果汁最适合饮用。

lines.en: : But didn’t you just talk about getting extra juices?
lines.zh: : 可你刚才不是还说可以多拿几罐果汁吗？

lines.en: : Correct! More juices means more juice. Everyone wins!
lines.zh: : 没错！果汁越多，果汁就越多。大家都赢！

lines.en: : But doesn’t that make it the same as just getting one larger juice from the store?
lines.zh: : 那不就跟从店里买一大罐果汁一样了吗？

lines.en: scene kaorihalloween9
: You are acting suspicious, Friend.
lines.zh: : 你的行为很可疑，朋友。

lines.en: : You speak so much of the convenient stores that I think you may believe all other stores are inconvenient.
lines.zh: : 你总是把便利店挂在嘴边，我都怀疑你是不是觉得其他所有店都不便利。

lines.en: : I mean...they kind of are, aren’t they?
lines.zh: : 我是说……本来就是，不是吗？

lines.en: : Of course not! You must support all local businesses to do your part in stimulating the economy!
lines.zh: : 当然不是！你必须支持所有本地商家，为刺激经济尽一份力！

lines.en: : Are you actually smart, Kaori?
lines.zh: : Kaori，你该不会其实挺聪明的吧？

lines.en: scene kaorihalloween6
: Maybe you are just not-smart?
lines.zh: : 也许只是你不聪明？

lines.en: : Juices contain vitamins and may help you retain knowledge, Friend.
lines.zh: : 果汁含有维生素，可能有助于你记住知识，朋友。

lines.en: : It may even help you with your trafficking of the tiny girls.
lines.zh: : 说不定还能帮你贩卖那些小小的女孩。

lines.en: : Teaching.
lines.zh: : 是教书。

lines.en: : Yes, it may help with that as well. It is very impressive how you can hold two completely different jobs at once.
lines.zh: : 对，那个也可能会有帮助。你能同时做两份完全不同的工作，真是了不起。

lines.en: : I only have one job. And don’t you hold like ten?
lines.zh: : 我只有一份工作。而你不是有十来份吗？

lines.en: : If you can carry meat in one place, you can carry meat in others.
lines.zh: : 如果你能在一个地方端肉，你就能在其他地方端肉。

lines.en: : Stealing girls is a specialized job that only someone large and attractive like you can manage.
lines.zh: : 拐卖女孩可是个专业活儿，只有像你这样高大又迷人的男人才做得来。

lines.en: : Are you flirting with me now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是在跟我调情吗？

lines.en: : No, I am offering valuable advice that may help you at some point in the future.
lines.zh: : 不是，我是在给你宝贵的建议，说不定什么时候能帮到你。

lines.en: : And calling me attractive is really part of that advice?
lines.zh: : 而说我迷人也是那建议的一部分？

lines.en: scene kaorihalloween10
: Gah! It is so complicated figuring out the differences between the words I say and the ones in my brain.
lines.zh: : 啊！要搞清楚我说出口的话和脑子里的话有什么区别，实在太难了。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I’m glad that you’re thinking about how attractive I am all the time.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我很高兴你一直都在想我有多迷人。

lines.en: scene kaorihalloween11
: Not all of the time! But yes! Many of the times!
lines.zh: : 不是一直！但是的！很多时候都在想！

lines.en: : The chickens are close now!
lines.zh: : 鸡就在附近了！

lines.en: : We should discuss those instead of my physical attraction to you!
lines.zh: : 我们应该聊鸡，而不是我对你肉体上的迷恋！

lines.en: I have to admit, chickens aren’t normally my first pick for a conversation topic, but it wouldn’t be very kind for me to force Kaori into flirting when she has a hard time even thinking straight.
lines.zh: 我得承认，鸡通常不是我聊天的首选话题，但既然 Kaori 连正常思考都费劲，我也不能硬逼着她跟我调情。

lines.en: scene black
Kaori immediately begins shouting out random words and hoping one of them will stick.
lines.zh: Kaori 立刻开始喊出一串随机的词，希望其中一个能接得上。

lines.en: The thing is, none of them do because they’re all just that. Random words.
lines.zh: 问题是，一个都接不上，因为它们就是那样——随机的词。

lines.en: None of them are anything that two sane people could discuss without some sort of...overarching topic or question surrounding them.
lines.zh: 没有一个是两个正常人能聊下去的——除非有某种……总体的话题或问题把它们串起来。

lines.en: Or I guess, in this case, one sane person and one of...whatever Kaori is.
lines.zh: 或者说，在这种情况下，一个正常人和一个……不管 Kaori 是什么东西的存在。

lines.en: scene kaorihalloween12
: Ahh! They’re still here!
lines.zh: : 啊！它们还在！

lines.en: : I was worried they would fly away!
lines.zh: : 我还担心它们会飞走呢！

lines.en: : Chickens can’t fly, Kaori.
lines.zh: : Kaori，鸡是不会飞的。

lines.en: : Not with that attitude!
lines.zh: : 有这种态度它们就飞得起来！

lines.en: Kaori walks me into a random alleyway in the middle of some random street and we are suddenly surrounded by a bunch of random chickens.
lines.zh: Kaori 把我带进某条随机的街道上一条随机的小巷，然后我们突然就被一群随机的鸡包围了。

lines.en: Well, I guess they aren’t entirely random given that she said they would be here.
lines.zh: 嗯，既然她说过它们会在这儿，那也不算完全随机。

lines.en: But still, nothing about this situation is normal.
lines.zh: 但不管怎么说，这处境没有一处是正常的。

lines.en: : I have returned, feathered friends!
lines.zh: : 我回来了，羽毛朋友们！

lines.en: : *Confused chicken noises*
lines.zh: *困惑的鸡叫声*

lines.en: : What are they doing?
lines.zh: : 它们在干什么？

lines.en: : It appears that they have formed a fellowship and are attempting to communicate with us.
lines.zh: : 看起来它们组成了一个团契，正试图与我们沟通。

lines.en: : Do you understand them?
lines.zh: : 你听得懂吗？

lines.en: : Of course not. They are chickens.
lines.zh: : 当然听不懂。它们是鸡啊。

lines.en: : I can barely understand humans, let alone silly looking birds.
lines.zh: : 我连人类都勉强才听得懂，更别说那些长得蠢兮兮的鸟了。

lines.en: : Okay, so now what?
lines.zh: : 好吧，那接下来呢？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : What do we do with the chickens?
lines.zh: : 我们要拿这些鸡怎么办？

lines.en: : We watch them.
lines.zh: : 我们看它们。

lines.en: : This is the only normal friendship-activity I know.
lines.zh: : 这是我所知道的唯一的正常交友活动。

lines.en: : This can hardly be called normal.
lines.zh: : 这可很难称得上正常。

lines.en: : Friend, why do you think they have gathered here of all places?
lines.zh: : 朋友，你觉得它们为什么偏偏聚集在这种地方？

lines.en: : An alleyway is not fit for chickens. They should be in the sky or a swimming pool.
lines.zh: : 小巷可不适合鸡待。它们应该在天上，或者在游泳池里。

lines.en: : They can’t swim either, Kaori.
lines.zh: : Kaori，它们也不会游泳。

lines.en: : Or...at least I don’t think they can? I honestly have no idea.
lines.zh: : 或者……至少我觉得它们不会？老实说我也完全不知道。

lines.en: I scan the alleyway for an actual chicken coop and, sure enough, I find one not more than twenty feet away from us filled with even more chickens.
lines.zh: 我扫视这条小巷，想找找有没有真正的鸡窝。果然，我在离我们不到二十英尺的地方找到了一个，里面还有更多鸡。

lines.en: My guess is that there’s a restaurant that uses this alley for smoke breaks or something and these chickens are just...part of their menu.
lines.zh: 我猜是有家餐厅把这条巷子当吸烟区之类的用，而这些鸡就是……他们菜单上的一部分。

lines.en: It’s a little odd seeing a man-made chicken coop in a city-alleyway, but at least it’s not totally nonsensical anymore.
lines.zh: 在城市小巷里看到一个人造鸡窝是有点怪，但至少现在这件事不算完全没道理了。

lines.en: : They’re probably being bred and raised back here before being killed.
lines.zh: : 它们大概是在这里被养殖长大，然后被宰掉的。

lines.en: scene kaorihalloween13
: Killed?...
: Yeah. There’s probably a restaurant back here that just raises their own chickens instead of buying pre-slaughtered ones to save money.
lines.zh: : 是啊。后面大概有家餐厅自己养鸡，而不是买已经宰好的，这样可以省钱。

lines.en: : Slaughtered?
lines.zh: : 宰好？

lines.en: : Do you see that chicken coop over there? There are even more inside.
lines.zh: : 你看到那边那个鸡窝了吗？里面还有更多。

lines.en: : If the chickens are going to be killed, why don’t they just run away?
lines.zh: : 如果这些鸡要被宰，它们为什么不逃跑？

lines.en: : Do they not fear death?
lines.zh: : 它们不怕死吗？

lines.en: : Well...they’re chickens. They’re not really known for their intellect.
lines.zh: : 嗯……它们是鸡。它们可不以聪明著称。

lines.en: : They probably just live back here passing the time until, eventually, the manager or owner or whoever else comes back here and snaps their neck.
lines.zh: : 它们大概就在这后面混日子，直到最后经理、老板还是谁来这儿，一下扭断它们的脖子。

lines.en: : The girl you met at the ramen shop did the same thing when she was little.
lines.zh: : 你在拉面店见过的那个女孩小时候也做过同样的事。

lines.en: scene kaorihalloween14
: Disgusting.
lines.zh: : 恶心。

lines.en: scene kaorihalloween15
: What was that?
lines.zh: : 你刚刚说什么？

lines.en: : We should free them. Shouldn’t we?
lines.zh: : 我们应该放了它们。不是吗？

lines.en: : That’s not really our choice, is it?
lines.zh: : 这可不是我们能决定的，对吧？

lines.en: : They belong to whoever owns the restaurant.
lines.zh: : 它们属于那家餐厅的老板。

lines.en: : No they don’t. They are fun and feathery and belong to everyone.
lines.zh: : 才不是。它们又好玩又有羽毛，属于所有人。

lines.en: : Do you not see the way they look at you? With admiration in their eyes and fire in their tiny, chickeny hearts?
lines.zh: : 你没看到它们看你的眼神吗？眼里充满崇拜，小小的鸡心里燃着火焰？

lines.en: : They just look like chickens to-
lines.zh: : 它们在我看来就是鸡而——

lines.en: scene kaorihalloween14
: Look harder.
lines.zh: : 再仔细看看。

lines.en: scene howtowish
PLAY ME A SONG THAT REMINDS ME OF BETTER DAYS.
lines.zh: 为我奏一曲，让我想起更好的日子。

lines.en: WRITE ME A HAPPY POEM AND WRAP IT IN SHARED MEMORIES.
lines.zh: 为我写一首快乐的诗，用共同的回忆把它包裹起来。

lines.en: THINGS FROM OUR YOUTH.
lines.zh: 来自我们青春的东西。

lines.en: ALLOW ME TO TAKE ALL OF THOSE MEMORIES FROM YOU.
lines.zh: 让我把你所有的那些回忆都拿走吧。

lines.en: I CAN FILL YOU WITH SUCH BEAUTIFUL THINGS.
lines.zh: 我能用如此美好的事物把你填满。

lines.en: BETTER MEMORIES.
lines.zh: 更好的回忆。

lines.en: BETTER EVERYTHING.
lines.zh: 更好的一切。

lines.en: ALL YOU NEED TO DO IS LISTEN.
lines.zh: 你要做的只是倾听。

lines.en: LISTEN TO ME AND NO ONE BUT ME.
lines.zh: 倾听我，除了我谁也别听。

lines.en: STOP LOOKING FOR ANSWERS.
lines.zh: 别再寻找答案了。

lines.en: PLEASE.
lines.zh: 求你了。

lines.en: IT WILL ONLY CAUSE YOU PAIN.
lines.zh: 那只会给你带来痛苦。

lines.en: YOU’LL RELIVE ALL OF THOSE HORRIBLE THINGS.
lines.zh: 你会重新经历所有那些可怕的事。

lines.en: THE SCREECH OF TIRES.
lines.zh: 轮胎的刺耳摩擦声。

lines.en: THE WEIGHT OF GOD PRESSING DOWN ON YOUR SHOULDERS AS YOU KNEEL DOWN AND REMOVE STRIPS OF STEEL FROM HER BODY.
lines.zh: 当你跪下、从她身上取下一条条钢片时，神的重量压在你的肩头。

lines.en: YOU SAW IT ALL.
lines.zh: 你看见了一切。

lines.en: YOU SEE IT ALL.
lines.zh: 你看见着一切。

lines.en: YOU SAW NOTHING.
lines.zh: 你什么也没看见。

lines.en: YOU SEE NOTHING.
lines.zh: 你什么也看不见。

lines.en: scene kaorihalloween16
: Friend!
lines.zh: : 朋友！

lines.en: : You are alive!
lines.zh: : 你还活着！

lines.en: Out of nowhere, I feel myself on the floor.
lines.zh: 不知不觉间，我发现自己已经躺在了地上。

lines.en: My legs are weak.
lines.zh: 我的腿发软。

lines.en: My mouth feels numb.
lines.zh: 我的嘴发麻。

lines.en: : What happened?
lines.zh: : 发生了什么？

lines.en: : What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 怎么回事？

lines.en: : You suddenly collapsed! This chicken saved your life!
lines.zh: : 你突然就倒下了！是这只鸡救了你的命！

lines.en: : It is proof that they must be saved! It is a sign!
lines.zh: : 这证明它们必须被拯救！这是一个征兆！

lines.en: : How did a chicken save my life?...
lines.zh: : 一只鸡是怎么救我的命的？……

lines.en: : It just did! Do not ask questions! You are too weak!
lines.zh: : 它就是救了！别问了！你太虚弱了！

lines.en: : Your head made a very loud sound when you landed but I observed its surface area and found no life-juice.
lines.zh: : 你落地的时候头发出了一声巨响，但我观察了它的表面积，没有发现生命汁液。

lines.en: : Are you dizzy? Do you need a wheelchair?
lines.zh: : 你晕吗？需要轮椅吗？

lines.en: : No...and I doubt you’d have one on hand either way.
lines.zh: : 不用……而且我怀疑你身上也不会有。

lines.en: Despite being on the ground and having apparently hit my head, I don’t feel much of anything.
lines.zh: 尽管我躺在地上，而且显然撞到了头，但我什么特别的感觉都没有。

lines.en: It’s just...a little strange being this close to a chicken.
lines.zh: 只是……离一只鸡这么近，感觉有点怪。

lines.en: scene black
I lift myself off of the ground and several of the other chickens who had gathered around me begin to run back to their coop.
lines.zh: 我从地上撑起来，几只围在我身边的鸡开始跑回它们的窝。

lines.en: scene kaorihalloween17
: Can you walk? Must I wrap my arms around your body and support you?
lines.zh: : 你能走吗？需要我用胳膊环住你的身体扶着你吗？

lines.en: : I can walk. I feel fine actually.
lines.zh: : 我能走。其实我感觉挺好的。

lines.en: : How long was I out for?
lines.zh: : 我昏过去多久了？

lines.en: : Twenty-three seconds. I counted.
lines.zh: : 二十三秒。我数了。

lines.en: : You should return to your residence and enter sleep-mode.
lines.zh: : 你应该回到住所，进入睡眠模式。

lines.en: : There will be more days where we can walk.
lines.zh: : 以后还有的是日子可以散步。

lines.en: : I hope today proved to you that chickens can be good, though.
lines.zh: : 不过，我希望今天向你证明了鸡也可以是好的。

lines.en: : Please tell me at least that much is true.
lines.zh: : 至少这一点，请你告诉我它是真的。

lines.en: : Sure, Kaori...
lines.zh: : 当然，Kaori……

lines.en: : You need to try and not get attached to things like chickens so quickly, though. People are always going to eat animals whether you like it or not.
lines.zh: : 不过你得试着别这么快就对鸡这种东西产生感情。不管你喜不喜欢，人类总会吃动物的。

lines.en: : I know this. I eat animals.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我也吃动物。

lines.en: : But these chickens are special! I want to protect them!
lines.zh: : 可这些鸡是特别的！我想保护它们！

lines.en: : I will use the money I receive from the Sara to free them!
lines.zh: : 我要用从 Sara 那儿拿到的钱把它们赎出来！

lines.en: : I don’t know if she’s going to pay you enough to buy out the entire stock of chickens, but I’ll support you however I can, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 我不知道她会付你多少钱，够不够把整批鸡都买下来，但我会尽我所能支持你，Kaori。

lines.en: scene kaorihalloween18
: Thank you, Friend. I will also support you when you decide to obtain a furry companion.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，朋友。等你决定要养一只毛茸茸的伙伴时，我也会支持你的。

lines.en: : Or a feathery companion, like a chicken.
lines.zh: : 或者羽毛伙伴，比如一只鸡。

lines.en: : And then I will come to your house and rub its belly three to seven times a week.
lines.zh: : 然后我每周会去你家，摸它的肚子三到七次。

lines.en: : I’m not planning on getting a pet any time soon, but sure. I’ll let my [niece] know.
lines.zh: : 我短期内没打算养宠物，不过行吧。我会告诉我[niece]的。

lines.en: : Your [niece] is the pretty girl with the red hair, yes? She is cute. I like her.
lines.zh: : 你的[niece]是那个红头发的漂亮女孩，对吧？她很可爱。我喜欢她。

lines.en: : Tell her that I said goodbye.
lines.zh: : 告诉她，我说再见。

lines.en: : Sorry, I mean hello. I still confuse those two things.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我是说你好。我还是会搞混这两个。

lines.en: : Sure. I’ll tell her as soon as I get home.
lines.zh: : 好。我一回家就告诉她。

lines.en: : Do you need the address for the bar tonight? I can text it to you if-
lines.zh: : 你需要今晚那家酒吧的地址吗？我可以发短信给——

lines.en: : I will find it on my own. Now go to where you and the tiny girl live and fall asleep!
lines.zh: : 我自己能找到。现在回你和小女孩住的地方，去睡觉！

lines.en: : ...Sure.
: I’ll see you tonight, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 今晚见，Kaori。

lines.en: scene black
Kaori and I walk out of the alleyway together and go our separate ways.
lines.zh: 我和 Kaori 一起走出小巷，然后各自分开。

lines.en: I have no idea what happened to me just now, but there’s a strange sensation somewhere in the back of my mind that feels like it’s trying to claw its way out.
lines.zh: 我不知道刚刚自己身上发生了什么，但脑海深处有某种奇怪的感觉，像是正试图抓开一条路冲出来。

lines.en: I shrug it off and realize that, a few hours from now, I’ll be surrounded by horny drunk women.
lines.zh: 我把它甩到一边，然后意识到：再过几个小时，我就会被一群发情的醉醺醺女人包围。

lines.en: Here’s hoping I don’t wind up collapsing in the middle of them next.
lines.zh: 但愿我下次别又在她们中间昏倒。
